items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: that's the way they operate, or who, what, where, why, and when, and how.

ctx.x: When you're putting a column like this together, what do you have to do to put a column? It looks like a lot of work, is what I'm saying.

What do you have to do to put a column? Well, in doing a column like that, number one, you have to be what is known in newspaper reports. You have to be on the scene. You have to have connections. You have to know people. And you have to get involved. And you have to ask questions. You know, like I raised my kids. I said, well, God gave us two hands, but I'm going to use one. And I'm going to educate you, and you never have to come back to me for many questions and answers. Who, what, where, why, and when. When…
So you must have been out all night.
